notes: The same-source proof instantiates original nraenv_to_nnrc_top_correct on the identical query AST and retains all five Print Assumptions blocks.
This proof is not axiom-free: upstream float/JsNumber/PrimFloat interfaces and Eqdep.Eq_rect_eq.eq_rect_eq remain explicit assumptions.
npm gitHead could not be recovered from the source repository; official npm functionality is separate from the source proof and is not a verified source-to-binary chain.
Parser, extraction, JavaScript runtime, other compiler passes and the native Coq implementation are outside this qualified proof.
Linux x86_64, Python 3.12 and Node.js are host prerequisites. The six locked Coq SDK debs are extracted into a fresh external temporary directory; no system Coq or apt installation is required.
